description: This file contains SCSS mixins and styles for implementing wave effects, including ripple animations, in a web UI. It defines styling for elements with the 'waves-effect' class and related variations, as well as transition and transform mixins.

methods.name: waves-transition
methods.description: A SCSS mixin for applying transition properties with vendor prefixes.

methods.description: A SCSS mixin for applying CSS transform with vendor prefixes.
